tool_input.command: for f in package.json index.html pigment.app.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts .gitignore README.md src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; ls pigment-snap.mjs 2>&1

foreach ($f in @('package.json','index.html','pigment.app.json','vite.config.ts','playwright.config.ts','.gitignore','README.md','src/main.tsx','src/App.tsx') + (Get-ChildItem src/components/*.tsx, src/pages/*.tsx, src/data/*.ts | % { $_.FullName }) + @('tests/smoke.spec.ts')) { "=== $f"; Get-Content -Raw $f }; Get-ChildItem -Name
